# Ensemble

A multiplayer, collaborative sandbox building game made with Godot 4, C#, .NET, and Avalonia 12.

![](/assets/images/ensemble_icon_square_colored.png "Ensemble Icon")

> [!NOTE]
> - This game is the direct successor to [Baja Builders](https://www.roblox.com/games/85484945236913) on Roblox.
> - Code quality may be "sub-par" while the codebase continues to mature.

> [!WARNING]
> This project is in the very early stages of development (pre-release) and should not be considered representative of
> future 1.x+ semantic versions. The primary intention of open-sourcing it is to get more eyes on the code and gather
> feedback.
